mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at 64 degrees at City Hall, and a full moon is out tonight. Expect an overnight low of 58 with no rain, and though the space station passes overhead, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Planning Department reports that scammers are impersonating city staff to solicit illegal payments for permit fees. Remember that all payments must be by check delivered to the administration building. Additionally, Fall Leaf Collection begins October 5, so keep your piles clear of street obstacles.

We have plenty going on, with Yoga at Insight Wellness and Hop Haus Trivia both happening today. Tomorrow, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run or head over to Hometown USA Festival Park for the popular Verona Fall Fest.
On September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for O W I, second offence, after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.
Culver's remains open until 10 PM today, but please be aware that the restaurant is currently closed for a remodel, meaning there is no flavor of the day available.
